<DIV align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><U><B>Re: Statement Concerning Today&#146;s Newspapers Report</B></U>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Today a certain news media organization carried an article concerning our business forecasts. The
concerned article is not based on any official announcements made by us.
We are planning to release our business results for the fiscal year ended March&nbsp;31, 2011 and
business projection for the fiscal year ending March&nbsp;31, 2012 on April&nbsp;27 (Wednesday).
